title: 多轮提示验证提升量化模型定性分析性能
summary: 研究量化LLM（8/4/3/2位）在定性分析中的表现，提出量化感知多轮提示验证方法，通过分步引导减少幻觉，提高低比特模型准确性和稳定性。使用82份访谈转录本和人工编码构建黄金标准验证。
summary_en: Examines quantized LLM performance (8/4/3/2-bit) in qualitative analysis, proposes quantization-aware multi-pass prompt verification to reduce hallucinations and improve accuracy. Uses 82 interview transcripts and human-coded gold standard for validation.
